desc.en: Reolink camera integration for ioBroker with direct Loxone Miniserver bridge. Motion and AI detection, doorbell push, PTZ, snapshots, WhiteLed knock-pattern gate trigger.
desc.de: Reolink-Kamera-Integration fuer ioBroker mit direkter Loxone-Miniserver-Bruecke. Bewegungs- und KI-Erkennung, Tuerklingel-Push, PTZ, Schnappschuesse, WhiteLed-Knock-Pattern als Tor-Trigger.
desc.pl: Integracja kamer Reolink dla ioBroker z bezposrednim mostem do Loxone Miniserver. Detekcja ruchu i AI, push dzwonka, PTZ, snapshoty, mrugniecie WhiteLed jako trigger bramy.

2.1.0.en: NVR support (Reolink RLN8/RLN16/RLN36): per-channel polling, state tree under <nvr>.chN.*, batch GetMdState+GetAiState in one HTTP request. New per-row flags isDoorbell (forces visitor capability), isNvr (NVR mode), pushToLoxone (silence duplicate VIs). VI list generator expands NVR rows into per-channel entries. Online heartbeat every 60 s. AI-only motion (drop GetMdState polling). Active doorbellRing pulse. Auth retry on rspCode -6 in error nest. Default poll interval 1 s.
2.1.0.de: NVR-Unterstützung (Reolink RLN8/RLN16/RLN36): Per-Kanal-Polling, State-Tree unter <nvr>.chN.*, batch GetMdState+GetAiState in einer HTTP-Anfrage. Neue Flags pro Zeile: isDoorbell, isNvr, pushToLoxone. VI-Listengenerator erweitert NVR-Zeilen um Per-Kanal-Einträge. Online-Heartbeat alle 60 s. KI-only-Motion. Aktive doorbellRing-Pulse. Auth-Retry bei rspCode -6 verschachtelt. Standard-Poll-Intervall 1 s.
2.1.0.pl: Wsparcie NVR (Reolink RLN8/RLN16/RLN36): polling per kanal, drzewo stanu pod <nvr>.chN.*, batch GetMdState+GetAiState w jednym zapytaniu HTTP. Nowe flagi per wiersz: isDoorbell (wymusza visitor capability), isNvr (tryb NVR), pushToLoxone (wycisza duplikaty VI). Generator listy VI rozwija wiersze NVR na wpisy per kanal. Heartbeat Online co 60 s. Motion oparte tylko na AI (bez GetMdState). Aktywne pulsy doorbellRing. Retry autoryzacji na rspCode -6 w error nest. Domyslny interwal polling 1 s.

2.0.0.en: Initial release. Full Reolink HTTP API + direct Loxone bridge (Token Auth or UDP). Push webhook with IP allowlist, shared secret and 64 KB body cap. WhiteLed knock-pattern gate trigger. Loxone Intercom on doorbell ring. ONVIF auto-discovery. Capability cache on disk. 53 unit tests, cross-platform CI.
2.0.0.de: Erstveroeffentlichung. Vollstaendige Reolink HTTP API + direkte Loxone-Bruecke (Token Auth oder UDP). Push-Webhook mit IP-Allowlist, Shared Secret und 64 KB Body-Cap. WhiteLed-Knock-Pattern als Tor-Trigger. Loxone Intercom beim Klingeln. ONVIF Auto-Discovery. Capability-Cache auf Platte. 53 Unit-Tests, plattformuebergreifendes CI.
2.0.0.pl: Pierwsza wersja. Pelne wsparcie Reolink HTTP API + bezposredni most do Loxone (Token Auth lub UDP). Webhook z allowlist IP, shared secret i limitem body 64 KB. Wykrywanie mrugniecia WhiteLed jako triggera bramy. Loxone Intercom przy dzwonku. Auto-wyszukiwanie ONVIF. Cache capabilities na dysku. 53 testy jednostkowe, CI cross-platform.
